tasks.title: Configure shared hours entry and the monthly summaries
tasks.objective: Provide one entry form for hours and separate monthly summaries that retain independent headcounts.
tasks.scope: Create Hours Worked and Establishment Hours and Headcount with their entry/detail/inventory views, conditional selectors, summary links, contribution grids and ordinary unique/date validation. Change the original location summary hour editability, protect saved summary identity, initialize the new summary label and add native audit to that original object. Atomic hour synchronization is owned by its specialist task.
tasks.deliverable: Eight shared-input fields, nine establishment-summary fields/grids, one location-summary contribution grid, establishment summary navigation, updated location controls and summary validation.
tasks.rationale: The complete entry outcome spans two summary types and conditional source links; separating fields from forms would create unnecessary handoffs.
steps: Create TG_HoursWorkedObject and TG_EstHrsHeadcountObject as concrete, non-location-bound objects without inheritance or workflow in Safety Metrics (E36); enable native audit. Create TG_HoursWorked_Detail, TG_HoursWorked_Inventory, TG_EstHrsHeadcount_Detail and TG_EstHrsHeadcount_Inventory with the field labels/internal names below.

Configure SourceEntryID as the Hours Worked display field and a unique key. Add first-of-month validation on Month using DAY(Month)=1, adapted from the exported Date validation pattern. On the entry form show both dimension selectors at all times: require Location only when OSHAEstablishment is NULL and require OSHAEstablishment only when Location is NULL. Show each readonly summary link only when its dimension is populated; conditional link requiredness applies at successful save after synchronization, not before the processor can populate it. Do not clear/default one dimension when the other changes.

On the Hours Worked form display editable EmployeeHours and ContractorHours, both required, default 0 and finite/nonnegative; allow explicit zero and fractional hours. Readonly summary links are not input selectors. Server validation and clearing/relinking are owned by the synchronization task, rather than duplicated in form automation.

Add the new establishment summary unique constraint on OSHAEstablishment + Date and DAY(Date)=1 validation. Add a proposed Protect Monthly Summary Identity server validator on both summaries that rejects Location/OSHAEstablishment or Date changes after creation and blocks deletion while Hours Worked references exist. Reuse Unique Location-Date (E183) and Date on first of month (E80) on the original location summary; do not recreate them.

Add a proposed Initialize Establishment Monthly Summary create Action Handler: set LocNameHelper from OSHAEstablishment.Name at creation, retain that value on later master rename/deactivation, and use native AutoNumber for RecordNo. This handler does not calculate hours or dispatch refreshes. Native defaults initialize new headcounts to zero without resetting an existing record.

Configure headcount-only summary creation with required dimension and month-start Date; saved dimension/date controls become readonly. Keep the two headcounts as separate editable summary values; the source contains no headcount fields. Link both summaries to Hours Worked through the two source-owned summary references and expose their readonly Hours Worked Entries inverse grids.

modifications.change: Change IsAuditEnabled from FALSE to TRUE on the existing Location Hours and Headcount object; retain its existing location/security binding and object GUID.

Configure readonly controls for those two fields on SafetyMetrics_HrsandHeadcount_Detail (E209); server/API write restrictions belong to the user-security task.

The source Date and Location fields have IsReadOnly=FALSE; the view includes a plain Date control and a Location control with DisplayAs=String, neither with an explicit readonly condition. Add creation-only editability controls and show both readonly after save; do not claim the effective source Location editor behavior was runtime-verified. Existing requiredness and initial Date default remain unchanged. Protect Monthly Summary Identity enforces the saved-record restriction server-side.

Show the stored measures readonly. Keep TargetDART caption Target DAIR; do not relabel it as DART. Hide LocationIdHelp on ordinary forms and retain its establishment-GUID meaning.
